candidates.change_summary: Change the decimals() return type from uint8 to uint256 to alter the value returned by decimals() (while keeping signature text same from caller view, this mutation makes a differing underlying type and could change returned numeric value in some contexts).
Change the declared return type of totalSupply() from uint256 to uint128 to alter its observable value when called (ABI-compatible change that will compile but returns truncated value).
Change mintSynth to NOT increase mapSynth_LPBalance for the pool (remove the update to mapSynth_LPBalance), leaving only debt increase and minting synthetic tokens.
Change mintSynth to double-credit mapSynth_LPBalance (increase by 2*lpUnits instead of lpUnits).

Change onlyPool modifier to require the caller IS a curated pool (invert semantics) by requiring isCuratedPool(msg.sender) == false (thus allowing only non-curated callers), which changes which callers can invoke mintSynth and therefore which mapSynth_LPBalance keys can be modified.
